scope.purpose: Reconstruct the six-task planning baseline after the Evaluation Contracts, Runtime Compliance Proof, storage boundary, information firewall, and joint promotion rule were frozen.
scope.selection_rule: Inspect the Canonical Current Row selected for each task; when that slot is null, inspect only the named closest Context Evidence. Never stitch task rows into a virtual incumbent.
scope.required_joint_baseline: One complete destination-compliant method identity with an eligible row on every task, exact contract bindings, legal cold-start state, and runtime-compliance-proof-v1 PASS.
scope.bounded_conclusion: No inspected row is eligible under the frozen destination. This matrix diagnoses the work needed to create the first Joint Development Baseline; it does not claim that the Six-Task Build Outcome is impossible.

cross_task_gap.reason: The repository has task-wise rows, separately trained sentinels, and mixed method identities, but no single eligible candidate paired with one Joint Development Baseline on identical six-task manifests and seeds {0,1,2}.
cross_task_gap.source_sam_observation: A source-SAM mapping candidate slightly improved the ScanNet paper8 context row while separately trained LERF sentinels were near-neutral and failed promotion. This is a hypothesis signal, not a negative-transfer measurement, because the executions are not one content-identical six-task candidate.
cross_task_gap.required_measurement: After one field family and task-agnostic mapping policy are selected, run the fixed six-task pilot with paired seeds {0,1,2}, report every task component and leximin gap closure, and apply the non-compensable floors.

resolution.rerun_reason: Every known route fails Eligibility Preflight before quality can establish a baseline. Replaying old evaluators without first producing an exact shared Method Contract, legal cold package, cache-free or legally rebuildable runtime, and runtime-compliance-proof-v1 would only create more Context Evidence.
resolution.minimum_next_execution: After the canonical field family and mapping-teacher policy are chosen, build one content-bound candidate, pass cold-state and runtime-compliance preflight, then execute the fixed paired six-task pilot under seeds {0,1,2}.
